items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: even my cousin that was over there in Paris then, he was on the top floor with his girlfriend

ctx.x: The next concert, to steady myself I went to the bar and got myself some brandy to fix me up and I went over there, and I saw the program was the same way, because it was different people. So like I said, I got this brandy and I drank it -- it was a small bottle anyhow, and I took that and got myself together, and I told Duke, 'I'm going

out there tonight; I'm going out there and I'm going to play 'Pyramid' Caravan or Perdido -- I'll play anything!" So I went over there and did my job, and even my cousin that was over there in Paris then, he was on the top floor with his girlfriend, and he said he noticed that I on the first one, was nervous or something. Well, anyhow, the second time, I played "Caravan," and everything was all right; I got up and took my bow, and acted just like a soldier, you know? I saluted and did everything, you know? I was…
But why were you so scared? You had been appearing in front of audiences for years.
